description: Help panel (application) follow-up eval, written 2026-10-09. Each case seeds the panel state the way application_runtime keeps it: the field on screen (help text from the Clean graph), the applicant's previous panel question (help_last_message) and the FAQ shown for it (help_last_faq, from faq_qa_records.json). Then 'message' is asked with the field as context and the outcome is scored. followup: true = the message only makes sense with context (previous question or the field on screen), false = self-contained, null = not a question (a statement or an answer). expect: {'answer': [ids]} = one of these FAQs should be answered (options containing one count as partial); {'no_answer': true} = no FAQ answers it, the panel should say so (no match, or 'the answer above is the closest'); {'same_or_answer': [ids]} = the FAQ already shown covers it, so pointing back to it or showing it again is correct. Labelled by one person (Claude, reviewed by nobody yet): treat the labels as a first pass and correct them where you disagree.

groups.F: follow-up that a different FAQ answers
groups.N: follow-up that no FAQ answers (must not be answered)
groups.S: follow-up that the FAQ just shown already covers
groups.C: self-contained control on the field, no history
groups.T: topic switch after a previous FAQ (must not be pulled towards the previous topic)
groups.V: vague message that depends on the field on screen
groups.A: an answer or statement typed into Help (not a question)
groups.O: out of scope or a request to assess the applicant's own case
groups.M: second-step follow-up (the previous question was itself a follow-up)
